title: A2UI Conformance Feature Registry Schema
description: Schema for conformance/features.yaml mapping protocol, blueprint, and SDK audit features to conformance test suites and claiming harnesses.

FeatureId.description: Canonical feature identifier from the core, agent, renderer, or blueprint audit tables.

HarnessId.description: Identifier of a conformance harness claiming support for a feature.

title.description: Human-readable summary of the feature requirement.

specAnchor.description: Repository-relative path and optional #heading-slug or #Lnn anchor to the specification or catalog source of truth.

blueprintAnchor.description: Repository-relative path and optional #heading-slug or #Lnn anchor to the module or feature blueprint.

claimedBy.description: Harnesses claiming compliance with this feature.

uncovered.description: Explanation when a feature has no tagged conformance YAML case yet (for example, covered only by unit or E2E tests, or tracked as an implementation gap).
